'''Chapter 865''' is titled "Hey, Mother".

==Cover Page==
[[The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet]]: Vol 2, [[Cavendish]] Arc: "I think you already know but in the past I...".

Cavendish begins talking about his past to [[Suleiman]].

==Short Summary==
[[Caesar Clown]] arrives at the venue and sets up the [[Mirro-World|escape mirror]] outside the door. He then takes a peek over the wall wondering why hasn't [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] screamed. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], however, was picking up the pieces of the portrait and attempted to show them to her again to make her scream. [[Charlotte Katakuri|Katakuri]] tries to stop him but the interference from [[Capone Bege|Bege]], [[Jinbe]] and [[Pedro]] prevented him from stopping Luffy. As Big Mom sees the broken remains of [[Carmel|Mother Carmel]]'s picture, she unleashes an inhuman scream that sent everything around her flying and [[Haki/Supreme King Haki|knocking out]] nearly everyone. With the distraction, [[Sanji]] was able to free [[Vinsmoke Family|his family]] and Bege is prepared to launch the [[KX Launcher|poison bullets]] at the now vulnerable [[Emperor]]. Big Mom, however, was lost in her grief, struggling to know why Mother Carmel left her on [[Elbaph]] 63 years ago.

==Long Summary==
[[Caesar Clown]] flies out of the giant mirror placed outside the wedding venue with [[Charlotte Brûlée|Brûlée]] still on his back, and Brûlée begs him to not show her face since she will be killed, but Caesar replies that they will know she is involved due to the alliance [[Mirro-World|using mirrors to get around]]. Caesar prepares to fly in the mirror and ensure the last stage of the plan happens smoothly, and he peeks over the wall to see [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]]'s state. To his surprise, however, Big Mom is not screaming even though the plan has been executed and [[Carmel]]'s portrait is destroyed.

Inside the venue, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] races to Big Mom in order to show her the shards of the Carmel portrait so she can focus her rage. [[Charlotte Katakuri|Katakuri]] angrily races at [[Capone Bege|Bege]] as the latter blocks him from taking action, and he tells [[Charlotte Perospero|Perospero]] to hurry and kill the [[Vinsmoke Family|Vinsmokes]]. Perospero taunts the Vinsmokes that their deaths are inevitable, and [[Vinsmoke Judge|Judge]] bitterly wishes that they had brought their raid suits, but Perospero questions why they would bring weapons to their son's wedding. [[Sanji]] then shouts for [[Vinsmoke Reiju|Reiju]] to run as he struggles to find his footing while running from [[Charlotte Daifuku|Daifuku]]'s [[Hoya Hoya no Mi|genie]], and Reiju reflects that Sanji going this far to save them gives her the knowledge that conscience still remains in their family, allowing her to be at peace. Meanwhile, Bege shoots Katakuri with several guns inside his [[Shiro Shiro no Mi|castle]], but they pass through Katakuri's [[Mochi Mochi no Mi|Special Paramecia body]]. He and the other Big Mom Pirates are shocked at Bege's outright betrayal, and as Luffy runs past the scene of the conflict, Katakuri attacks him with a mochi leg. However, [[Pedro]] steps in and slices up the mochi, but gets his sword caught in its stickiness. [[Jinbe]] attacks Katakuri with [[Fish-Man Karate]], but Katakuri dodges him before moving past him. He leaps at Luffy and slams a giant mochi arm into him, pinning him to the ground, but at the last second Luffy stretches out his arms to the front of Big Mom's face, allowing her to see the portrait shards again.

Big Mom grabs the portrait shards and fully realizes the damage done to it, as Katakuri and Perospero get very scared, she unleashes a great cry which shakes the entire venue. Some people are knocked out by her blast of [[Supreme King Haki]], while others resist the Haki but are rendered motionless due to the sound of her high-pitched cry. [[Vito]] and [[Gotti]] then jump out of Bege's body with their weapons in tow, and Big Mom scrapes her knee as she drops onto it, shocking [[Charlotte Galette|Galette]]. Meanwhile, [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] inserts earplugs into Reiju's ears, and Sanji frees all of his family from their bindings with [[Black Leg Style/Diable Jambe|Diable Jambe]] kicks while [[Nami]] and [[Carrot]] guard the table. [[Charlotte Smoothie|Smoothie]] begs someone to stop Bege and his crew, and as Bege, Vito, and Gotti prepare to fire their [[KX Launcher]]s, a distraught Big Mom thinks about Mother Carmel and her departure 63 years ago on [[Elbaph]].

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Caesar Clown|Caesar]] has prepared the [[Mirro-World|escape mirror]].
*The [[Big Mom Pirates]] learn of [[Capone Bege|Bege]]'s treachery.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] shows [[Carmel|Mother Carmel]]'s broken picture to [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] again, causing her to start her strange scream and go into her vulnerable state.
**She is shown crying for the first time.
**[[Capone Bege|Bege]], [[Vito]], and [[Gotti]] prepare to fire their [[KX Launcher]]s to assassinate her.
*[[Sanji]] frees his [[Vinsmoke Family|family]] from their restraints as his fellow crewmates provide them with earplugs and their gear.
*[[Elbaph]] is seen for the first time.
